text: A can do a work in 10 days, B in 15 days. Together they complete it in:
explanation: A's 1 day work = 1/10, B's = 1/15. Together = 1/10 + 1/15 = 5/30 = 1/6. So 6 days.
objective: A's 1 day work = 1/10, B's = 1/15. Together = 1/10 + 1/15 = 5/30 = 1/6. So 6 days.

text: Given n pipes with fill/empty rates (positive=fills, negative=empties), find time to fill tank. Return -1 if never fills.
explanation: Net rate = sum of all rates. If net > 0, time = 1/net. If net <= 0, never fills.
objective: Net rate = sum of all rates. If net > 0, time = 1/net. If net <= 0, never fills.

subject: aptitude
text: A product's price is increased by x% then decreased by x%. Net change?
explanation: Let price = 100. After +x%: 100(1+x/100). After -x%: 100(1+x/100)(1-x/100) = 100(1-x²/10000). Net change = -x²/100%. Always a decrease.
objective: Let price = 100. After +x%: 100(1+x/100). After -x%: 100(1+x/100)(1-x/100) = 100(1-x²/10000). Net change = -x²/100%. Always a decrease.
